metadata.user_request: make a simple EMA crossover strategy that uses 30 and 70 periods crossing each other for entry. Open long positions when 30 ema crosses above 70 ema and enter short position when 70 ema crosses below 30 ema. The stop loss should be set 15 pips from entry and take profit should be 70 pips from entry

items.title: Implement Complete EMA Crossover Strategy
items.description: Implement complete trading strategy with: (1) Data loading from CSV/API with OHLCV validation, (2) Indicator calculation: 30-period Exponential Moving Average (EMA) and 70-period EMA, (3) Entry conditions: Open long position when 30 EMA crosses above 70 EMA; Open short position when 30 EMA crosses below 70 EMA, (4) Exit conditions: Stop Loss at 15 pips from entry price, Take Profit at 70 pips from entry price. The strategy must include a complete backtest runner with SimBroker adapter, explicit loop termination (e.g., max_iterations), robust error handling, and comprehensive logging. The 'pips' value should be interpreted relative to the instrument's price scale (e.g., 0.0001 for forex pairs, or a fixed absolute value based on configuration).
